Responsible Use of AI in Education

AI in education should be used responsibly and carefully. Student information must be protected, and personal data should not be shared without permission. AI systems may sometimes produce incorrect or biased results. Teachers and educational institutions should check AI-generated information and ensure that technology is used fairly and transparently.
